7.   Consent Agenda
     All items in this portion of the agenda are considered to be routine and non-controversial
     by the Council and may be approved by one motion; however, a member of the Council
     may request that an item be removed for separate consideration under the appropriate
     committee report:

     A.   ORDINANCE 65-2025-26 (SECOND READING) [ZONING CASE Z-10-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Batson-East Land Company, Inc, for a zone change on a tract of land
          consisting of one full parcel and a portion of another, located on the northern
          frontage of Edgewood Pl, 950 +/- feet west of Wilma Rudolph Blvd & Edgewood Pl
          intersection from AG Agricultural District to C-5 Highway & Arterial Commercial
          District.

     B.   ORDINANCE 70-2025-26 (SECOND READING) [ZONING CASE Z-16-2026]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,

8.   Finance Committee: Chairman Stacey Streetman

     A.   ORDINANCE 67-2025-26 (First Reading) An Ordinance authorizing the exercise of

          improvements required to facilitate design and construction of various
          projects. Finance Committee and Gas & Water Board: Approval

     B.   ORDINANCE 68-2025-26 (First Reading) An Ordinance approving the conveyance

          Montgomery County Museum. Finance Committee: Approval

     C.   RESOLUTION 55-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing an interlocal agreement
          between the City of Clarksville, TN and Montgomery County TN pertaining to utility

          and Gas & Water Board: Approval

     D.   RESOLUTION 56-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing a memorandum of
          understanding between the City of Clarksville, Tennessee and the Clarksville Arts &
          Heritage Development Council. Finance Committee: Approval

     E.   RESOLUTION 60-2025-26 Initial Resolution authorizing the issuance of not to
          exceed $42,500,000 in aggregate principal amount of one or more series of general
          obligation bonds of the City of Clarksville, Tennessee. Finance Committee:
          Approval




                                               3
     F.   RESOLUTION 61-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing the issuance of not to exceed
          $42,500,000 in aggregate principal amount of one or more series of general
          obligation bonds of the City of Clarksville, Tennessee, authorizing the issuance of
          bond anticipation notes prior to the issuance of the bonds in an amount not to
          exceed the maximum aggregate principal amount of said bonds; making provision
          for the issuance, sale and payment of said bonds and notes; establishing the terms
          thereof and the disposition of proceeds therefrom; and providing for the levy of
          taxes for the payment of debt service and the bonds and notes. Finance
          Committee: Approval
